title: Shorts: scripts waiting for review
subtitle: Tick 'approve' (voice + animation can start) or 'needs changes' for each script. Comment on details on that short's PLAN.html page (03_shorts/<folder>/PLAN.html). Showcases get the full animation first (Q16).
warning: Nothing is voiced or animated until approved here (Q17). Shorts must be 3:00 or less with pauses, so treat ~2:45 of speech as the ceiling; QWERTY (~2:47) is over it and needs a cut. Approving costs about $0.05 of TTS per short.

sections.title: Approve (voice + animation can start)
sections.intro: Showcases first (Q16). Each row: what the short says, then its open review points.

detail: Open: U-p terms, U-q name the discrete logarithm?, U-r keep the GCHQ beat?

items.note: Hook = try writing «ճնճղուկ» in Greek letters; author, year, first sentence; one sound one letter, the Greek order kept, the 36 letters as a 4 x 9 number grid; closes on 'the kingdom was lost, the script stayed'. Fable review applied.

items.title: Approve: Why English spelling is a mess (english_spelling, 8 beats, ~1:43)

items.title: Approve: Why the week has 7 days (week_seven, 9 beats, ~1:54)
items.note: Sky gives day, month, year, not the week; Jewish Sabbath week (Armenian names count from it); Roman planet days; named after the first hour + 24 mod 7 = 3 draws a seven-pointed star; Soviet weeks failed. Fable review applied.
detail: Open: U-ss ուրբաթ etymology, U-tt terms, U-uu Soviet detail

items.title: Approve: Why a minute has 60 seconds (minute_60, 6 beats, ~1:40)
items.note: Hook = a real 10-hour French clock (the metre stayed, decimal time did not); count to 60 on your hands; 60 divides well (a third of 100 never ends); minuta / secunda; 'sixty divides well, ten comes from our fingers'. Fable review applied.
detail: Open: U-vv the Russian link, U-ww closing line too strong?

items.title: Approve: The decoy effect (medium popcorn) (decoy_popcorn, 10 beats, ~1:52)
items.note: The medium sells the large; the viewer chooses before the medium appears; the 84% vs 32% magazine demo; comparing is easy, pricing is hard; no effect with real products, it holds for numbers. Fable review applied.
detail: Open: U-xx term «խայծի էֆեկտ», U-yy Ariely on the source line, U-zz «ադիբուդի»

items.title: Approve: The IKEA effect (ikea_effect, 7 beats, ~1:21)
items.note: Builders pay 63% more for their own box; named IKEA effect; crooked origami frogs; only if finished; it becomes 'my box'; grandfather's fence. Cake-mix legend cut. ~1:20. Fable review applied.
detail: Open: U-aaa brand in the voice, U-bbb local touch

items.title: Approve: Map projections (Greenland vs Africa) (map_projection, 9 beats, ~1:46)
items.note: Africa is 14x Greenland; drag Greenland south, lift Armenia north (x6); orange peel and Gauss; why Mercator stretched (sailors); every map sacrifices something; try zooming out in Google Maps. Fable review applied.
detail: Open: U-ccc «պրոյեկցիա» once?, U-ddd «Գուգլ քարտեզները»

items.note: Your structure: gossip hook, websites and banks, the cave, why 'zero knowledge' (a video of it convinces nobody), the red card (all 26 black cards still in the deck), the colour-blind balls, real systems, back to the gossip. Approve = you record.

items.note: Frame 0 = white original next to its tagged reconstruction; traces under UV / infrared; the Peplos Kore; why we thought white, the 1930s scraping; our churches had frescoes (Akhtamar); the copies are hypotheses. Fable review applied.

items.note: Physics only (Fable's option a, U-jjj default): textbook says zero work, yet you sweat (your body lifts the load each step); wheels give it to the floor, if the floor is smooth (Yerevan pavements). ~1:20. Fable review applied.
